description: Live coverage counts (rows, filers, per-source totals) measured from the serving views. Prefer these numbers over any cached figure.
name: get_coverage

age_header.description: The name of the response header that reports how long a cache held this body, or null when no cache is permitted to hold it, as here. Public record responses name the Age header.

browser_max_age_seconds.description: Seconds a browser or client cache may reuse this body without revalidating; 0, the max-age the Cache-Control header carries.

cdn_max_age_seconds.description: Seconds the CDN may reuse this body; 0, because CDN-Cache-Control is no-store. Public record responses declare a nonzero value here; measurements never do.

declared_max_staleness_seconds.description: The upper bound on how old this body can be when it reaches a client, counted from generated_at; 0 for a measurement, and the same number the X-Veridion-Cache-Max-Staleness header carries.

policy.description: The cache contract this response was served under; always no-store for a measurement. Rendered as Cache-Control: no-store, max-age=0 with CDN-Cache-Control and Vercel-CDN-Cache-Control: no-store, and echoed in X-Veridion-Cache-Policy.

age_seconds.description: Nonnegative whole seconds from summary measured_at to response generation; null without a valid summary timestamp.

amount_disclosed_pct.description: 100 times amount_disclosed_rows divided by warehouse_rows, rounded to one decimal place; null for zero warehouse rows. Both counts include superseded rows.

amount_disclosed_rows.description: Rows with amount_mid, or both amount_low and amount_high from which the summary derives a midpoint; not a count of exact transaction values. Includes superseded warehouse rows at the summary measurement, not only live or served rows.

denominator.description: The examined sibling count supplies this rate's denominator.

numerator.description: The populated sibling count supplies this rate's numerator.

affected_rows.description: Active House serving rows with null source_line_number in this reason class: fallback parser or named parser output. Closed versions excluded; both classes must sum to the House field gap.
Active House serving rows in the complete bounded parser-gap read for this document, with a named non-fallback parser but null source_line_number; closed versions excluded.

population_basis.description: Active House Clerk and Senate eFD serving versions with valid_to unset; closed versions are excluded. Counts are separate reads, not a generation-pinned snapshot. The bounded parser-gap register must contain every counted parser gap or rates are withheld. These counts do not test URL resolution.

rows_examined.description: Active House plus Senate row counts when both were measured before a later validation failed; zero is also the legacy no-examination sentinel, not evidence of an empty corpus. Rates are withheld.

licensed_feed_document_reference_rows.description: Summary count without a first-party receipt-link marker but with a valid HTTPS URL, carried after arithmetic reconciliation; not a row-level collection-channel match. Includes superseded warehouse rows at the summary measurement, not only live or served rows.

licensed_feed_rows_total.description: Collection-channel licensed total carried from provenance after the two partitions reconcile; independently timed measurement. Includes superseded warehouse rows at the summary measurement, not only live or served rows.

licensed_feed_rows_without_document_refe.description: licensed_feed_rows_total minus licensed_feed_document_reference_rows after partition checks; an arithmetic bridge, not a joined row census. Includes superseded warehouse rows at the summary measurement, not only live or served rows.
100 times licensed_feed_rows_without_document_reference divided by licensed_feed_rows_total, rounded to one decimal place; null for zero denominator. Both include superseded rows.
100 times licensed_feed_rows_without_document_reference divided by rows_examined, rounded to one decimal place; null for zero denominator. Both include superseded rows.

population_basis.description: Arithmetic reconciliation of the two retained congressional warehouse partitions, both including superseded rows, at their separately reported measurement timestamps. Matching totals are not proof of row-level identity or an explanation of the warehouse-to-serving gap. Unavailable bridge counts are withheld.

rows_examined.description: Retained congressional warehouse rows in the collection-channel total, including superseded rows, after arithmetic agreement with the separately timed summary; not a row-level join.

population_basis.description: Arithmetic reconciliation of the two retained congressional warehouse partitions, both including superseded rows, at their separately reported measurement timestamps. Matching totals are not proof of row-level identity or an explanation of the warehouse-to-serving gap. Unavailable bridge counts are withheld.

rows_examined.description: Available retained collection total, else available summary warehouse total, else the legacy zero sentinel for an unmeasured population. Includes superseded rows when measured; zero here does not establish an empty warehouse.

serving.description: Rows /v1/disclosures returns right now, counted from the serving view at read time after every exclusion. Not the count of rows that qualify. Every count is nullable because the measurement reports unavailable rather than guessing when it cannot reach the view.

executive.description: Active serving versions whose chamber is executive; closed versions excluded, separate exact-count read, null if unavailable.

house.description: Active serving versions whose chamber is house; closed versions excluded, separate exact-count read, null if unavailable.

senate.description: Active serving versions whose chamber is senate; closed versions excluded, separate exact-count read, null if unavailable.

house_clerk.description: Active serving versions whose source_system is house_clerk; closed versions excluded, separate exact-count read, null if unavailable.

oge.description: Active serving versions whose source_system is oge; closed versions excluded, separate exact-count read, null if unavailable.

senate_efd.description: Active serving versions whose source_system is senate_efd; closed versions excluded, separate exact-count read, null if unavailable.

total_rows.description: Exact count of active serving versions (valid_to is null), excluding closed versions. Separate read from the source and chamber counts, not a generation-pinned census; null if unavailable.

publishing.description: Whether this office publishes rows into v1 today. sec_edgar is listed and false: it is the declared scope boundary, not an omission. A reader should learn the boundary from the response rather than infer it from a query that returns nothing.
